intro.h2: Pick it in person, then let the same team build it
paragraphs: Guthrie Kitchen & Bath Plus offers kitchen remodeling in Pleasant View, TN from its own 7,000 square foot showroom on Industrial Drive. You can handle cabinets, countertops, plumbing fixtures, hardware, tile and flooring before you commit, and work through the layout with a designer on the spot.

Then you decide how much help you want. Services range from complete designs and end-to-end design/build to simply selecting and ordering products, and smaller updates like new countertops or a refreshed vanity are welcome. Guthrie is also the local authorized dealer for The Galley Ideal Workstation, with a full working display in the showroom.

services.h2: Kitchen remodeling in Pleasant View, TN and the rooms beyond it

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: Cabinetry, countertops, flooring, lighting and a layout that works, planned with a designer trained on 20/20 design software. When a dishwasher leak stripped one client's kitchen to the subfloor, Guthrie rebuilt it from flooring to countertops to electrical and plumbing.

image.alt: Kitchen remodel with white shaker cabinets, a large white quartz island on a dark base, wood-look floor and stainless appliances

items.name: Bathroom Remodeling
items.blurb: Spacious showers, custom vanities and finishes you can see in the showroom first. A Springfield bath paired a freestanding tub with a custom alcove shower, Delta showerhead, recessed niche with glass shelves, built-in bench and green glass wall tile from Lia.

image.alt: Spa-style bathroom in Springfield, TN with a freestanding tub, blue-green glass subway tile shower and built-in linen shelves

items.name: Countertops
items.blurb: Granite, quartz, Corian, laminate, cultured marble, soapstone, butcher block, stainless steel, tile and glass. The team takes the mystery out of measurements, materials and money, and one client wrote that a free estimate from Guthrie made granite countertops affordable after all.

image.alt: Clarksville, TN kitchen with a speckled granite peninsula, white shaker cabinets, black range hood and navy counter stools

items.name: Multi-Space Remodeling
items.blurb: Projects that cross several rooms or add on to the house. One client's remodel covered two and a half baths, the kitchen, the dining room and the laundry, with walls opened up along the way. Guthrie coordinates the products and trusted subcontractors so every room finishes as one design.

image.alt: Primary bathroom from a multi-room remodel with white veined tile, a frameless glass shower enclosure, freestanding tub and dark wood vanity

items.name: Closets, Laundry Rooms and More
items.blurb: The design team works on any room that benefits from cabinetry, storage, lighting, flooring and an efficient layout. That includes walk-in closets and pantries, mudrooms, laundry rooms, garages, home offices, fireplace surrounds and outdoor spaces, with the same showroom products to choose from.

why_choose_us.h2: Why homeowners from Clarksville to Franklin come to Pleasant View

items.title: Touch it before you buy it
items.text: The 7,000 square foot showroom displays cabinets, countertops, tile, plumbing fixtures and hardware, plus a flooring store, so you choose with your own eyes instead of from a catalog.

items.title: An owner who knows cabinets
items.text: Mike Guthrie has worked in construction since 1982 and fell for cabinetry and countertops at a millwork company. Reviewers describe him as honest, detail-oriented and knowledgeable about granite.

items.title: Crews you can let in the house
items.text: Guthrie is a fully licensed contracting firm, and its employees and tradespeople are licensed, insured and have all passed background checks before they work in your home.

items.title: Start at any size
items.text: Swap a vanity, replace countertops or remodel several rooms at once. Free design consultations and available financing let you start the conversation where your budget is.

about.text: Mike Guthrie went to work for a convenience store chain right after high school and rose from clerk to district manager within four years. In 1982 he moved into construction, and a winter job offer from the owner of a millwork company changed his direction: he was hooked on cabinetry, countertops and woodworking. Today he runs Guthrie Kitchen & Bath Plus from its Pleasant View showroom with designer Heather Dickson, who trained on 20/20 Design Software and is studying for NKBA certification, plus purchasing and accounting staff and a team of trusted subcontractors.

service_area.h2: Six Middle Tennessee counties, one Pleasant View showroom
service_area.text: Guthrie's showroom at 1040 Industrial Dr in Pleasant View sits in Cheatham County, and the team also works across Davidson, Robertson, Sumner, Montgomery and Williamson counties. That reaches Nashville neighborhoods such as Bellevue and Green Hills, Clarksville and Sango, Springfield and White House, Gallatin and Hendersonville, and Franklin and Brentwood. Every town the firm lists is below.

faq.h2: Questions to ask before your showroom visit

items.q: Can I just buy cabinets or countertops from you?
items.a: Yes. Guthrie's services range from complete design and end-to-end design/build to simply selecting and ordering products. One Google reviewer bought cabinetry, countertops and flooring for a 1980s home and was pleased from start to finish. Tell the design team what you need and they will match the level of help to your project.

Yes. Guthrie offers free design consultations, and you can book one from any page of the site or by calling (615) 247-5091. You talk through the space, your style and your budget with the design team while looking at real cabinets, countertops, tile and fixtures on the showroom floor.

Yes. Financing is available for kitchen, bath and other remodeling projects, and the showroom works with a home improvement loan partner. Ask about current terms during your free consultation so the budget conversation covers both the design you want and how you would like to pay for it.

items.q: Are your installers licensed and insured?
items.a: Yes. Guthrie describes itself as a fully licensed contracting firm, and its employees and tradespeople are licensed and insured and have all passed background checks. The company also lists NAHB and National Tile Contractors Association memberships and BBB accreditation among the organizations it works with.

items.q: Do you only work on kitchens and baths?
items.a: No. The team designs any space that benefits from cabinetry, storage, lighting, flooring and an efficient layout, including closets and pantries, mudrooms, laundry rooms, garages, home offices, fireplace surrounds and outdoor spaces. Partial updates count as well, such as new countertops, new flooring or a refreshed bathroom vanity.

final_cta.h2: Come see the products in person
final_cta.text: Visit 1040 Industrial Dr, Ste 114 in Pleasant View, Monday to Friday 8am to 5pm or Saturday 9am to 2pm, or call (615) 247-5091 to book a free design consultation.

current_site_defects: Measured: Google PageSpeed Insights mobile performance score 17, the lowest of this batch.
The founding year conflicts: the footer, meta description and FAQ say 2012, while the home page and team page say January 2013.
Title and H1 say 'Nashville Kitchen & Bath Remodeling' although the showroom and Google profile are in Pleasant View, which never appears in the title tag.
All 39 FAQ answers sit in collapsed accordions and are not in the page text, so search engines and skimmers see questions without answers.
Site testimonials are undated and the same list repeats twice on the About page; the Google rating (4.2 from 33) is not addressed anywhere.
Badge labelling is off: the footer 'HFS Member' badge is actually a loan advert, and an About page logo labelled NAHB shows the NKBA mark.
The products section leans on stock filler wording instead of naming the brands and displays a visitor can see in the showroom.

Key FAQ answers (product-only purchases, free consults, financing, licensing) written out in plain text on the home page.
Showroom visit made the main conversion, with hours, address and tap-to-call (615) 247-5091 in the hero and closing section.
Gallery built from real Clarksville, Springfield and Pleasant View projects with town-specific alt text.
